title: PCNA pocket handoff
description: The file Rishi's GPU run produces and sends back. It fully describes ONE model-identified candidate pocket with its provenance, so Advay can generate a tailored MD-validation pocket JSON (pockets/<name>.json) with no guesswork. Compute is done by Rishi; this file is the clean interface between his run and the MD harness.

pocket_name.description: Short slug for the candidate, e.g. 'cand_A_2026-07'. Becomes pockets/<name>.json.

identified_on_pdb.description: PDB id the GNN scored to find this pocket (e.g. a PCNA structure). Residue numbers below are in THIS structure's PDB author numbering.

pocket_residues_resseq.description: The residues the model actually scored into this pocket (after DBSCAN clustering), PDB author numbering. NOT hand-picked — the clustered model output.

score_summary.description: Per-residue score stats so the magnitude of the signal is visible, not just membership.

apo_pdb.description: Structure to simulate as the CLOSED/apo state for MD (default true apo '1W60').

control_pdb.description: Structure where this pocket is known OPEN (holo), used as the MD positive control. Set null if none exists for a genuinely novel site — the MD harness will then correctly report 'inconclusive', never a false negative.

git_commit.description: Commit of the code that produced this (must be on/after the merged graph-leakage-fix).

checkpoint.description: Path + SHA256 of the model checkpoint used.

split_file.description: The split manifest, so the run is reproducible and not the pocket's own structure being in train.

leakage_fixed.description: TRUE only if this run used the leakage-fixed graphs (BUG-020/021/022 landed). Do not hand back a pre-fix result.

novelty_check.description: Output of scripts/check_prediction_overlap.py on pocket_residues_resseq. Prevents overstating novelty.

classification.description: 'not_in_any_known_region' is NOT a novelty claim on its own; per governance doc 12 it needs the full PCNA audit + human review.

gate6_approval_recorded.description: TRUE only if the GATE 6 (PCNA inference) approval is recorded in PROJECT_STATE.md before this run.
